ca_file.description: Path to the CA certificate file used to validate peer certificates.

cert_expiry.renew_days.description: Start automatic certificate renewal this many days before expiry.

cert_expiry.warn_days.description: Alert operator when certificate expires in fewer than this many days.

cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file used to authenticate this node.

control.listen.description: Address for local control/mgmt API (e.g., health, metrics, push).

control_cert.ca_file.description: CA cert to validate control API clients.

control_cert.cert_file.description: TLS cert for control API (mTLS required).

firewall_default_inbound_action.description: Fallback action for unmatched inbound traffic.

firewall_default_outbound_action.description: Fallback action for unmatched outbound traffic.

firewall_rules.description: List of firewall rules to control traffic routing within the overlay.

port.description: Port or range (e.g., '22', '80-90', or '' for all)

proto.description: Protocol (tcp, udp, icmp, or '' to match all)

ip.description: Public IP address of this host, visible to peers (optional; used for NAT traversal and lighthouse registration).

key_file.description: Path to the private key file corresponding to the certificate.

lighthouse.description: Whether this node should act as a lighthouse (participant in peer discovery).

lighthouse_remotes.description: List of known lighthouse addresses to query during bootstrap.

port.description: Lighthouse port (optional if embedded in host string).

listen_addr.description: IP address on which to listen for incoming Nebula connections.

log_file.description: Optional path to write logs to (stdout if empty).

mtu.description: Maximum transmission unit (MTU) for the Nebula tunnel interface.

port.description: UDP port to listen on for Nebula traffic.

psk_file.description: Path to a file containing a per-connection pre-shared key (optional, adds an extra layer of encryption).

pulse.enabled.description: Enable pulse probing to check health of connected peers.

relay_hosts.description: List of known relay host IPs or hostnames.

relays_enabled.description: If true, this node may act as a relay to forward traffic between peers behind symmetric NATs.

static_host_mapping.description: Static mapping from Nebula IPs to public endpoints for peers without dynamic discovery.

subnet.description: IPv4 CIDR subnet to assign to this node's Nebula interface (must match network-wide plan).

tun.dev.description: Name of the tun interface to create (Linux only).

tun.disabled_offloads.description: List of kernel offload features to disable on the tun device (prevents checksum errors).
